title: more than 120 injured fire russian gas chemical complex one chinese worker 2026 08 25
text:
MOSCOW, Aug 25 (Reuters) - At least 19 people were being treated in ​hospital and more than a hundred ‌more suffered injuries after a fire broke out on Tuesday at a gas chemical complex under ​construction in Russia's Far East, killing ​one Chinese national.
"Despite prompt medical attention, ⁠one of the victims — a Chinese ​national employed by a contractor — could not ​be saved. His family will receive support, including financial assistance," the facility in the Amur region ​said in a statement.
The complex, which ​bills itself as one of the world's largest polyethylene ‌and ⁠polypropylene producers, is a joint project of Russian company Sibur and Chinese oil and gas company Sinopec. It has yet ​to start ​production.
Russia ⁠frequently employs cheap foreign labour, including from China, for construction of ​large infrastructure projects.
The facility said ​work ⁠was continuing at the site to extinguish the blaze and specialists were carrying out ⁠a ​controlled burn of the ​remaining industrial gases.
